description: Fund the x402 evidence commons: a $0.10 contribution that keeps Agoranome's evidence lookups, Fair Offer checker and buyer policy pack free. Returns a signed receipt; 15% goes to the cause Agoranome pledges to, verifiable at /impact/ledger. Nothing else is delivered, and a contribution never changes a result, a rank or a certification. Price: $0.10 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.10 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
